meta.title: A vendor cannot change the event's owner
gaps: change_ownership endpoint uses raw library request rather than native op
it does not read the record back to confirm what was kept or shown

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer sends the event groups change ownership request, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not authorized to perform this action”, and never with a server error.
